jobs.title: Consultant Town Planner
jobs.description:
Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Start here. Grown Here.

We have an opportunity for a Consultant Town Planner.
AECOM’s Planning and Stakeholder Engagement business is recruiting Consultant Planners to help deliver our existing portfolio of projects and a pipeline of projects, across a range of sectors, principally delivering large scale infrastructure.

As our Town Planning team is national, and we support hybrid working we are flexible in terms of base location. The role can be based from our offices in Basingstoke, and London Aldgate
with an option for hybrid working.

Here’s what you’ll do:

You will be joining a market leading, experienced infrastructure planning team and will, be given the following responsibilities.

Planning & Development Management

Assist in the management and successful delivery of major development applications.
Provide planning advice to colleagues and clients, including the application of permitted development rights.
Carry out planning research and analysis and assist with the identification of planning risks.

Technical Reporting & Documentation

Prepare Planning Statements and Design and Access Statements to support development applications.
Liaise with the Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) team to ensure coordinated project delivery.

Project Coordination & Delivery

Help coordinate multi-disciplinary teams across a variety of project types.
Assist with project management activities to support successful project outcomes.
Implement quality assurance and health and safety principles.

Business Development & Commercial Support

Contribute to the preparation of successful commercial tenders.

Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

Participate in internal and external meetings.
Build effective working relationships with colleagues, clients, and project stakeholders.

Does this sound like something you can do, and do well? If so, read on…

MORE ABOUT THE WORK
- We believe infrastructure creates opportunity for everyone. Whether it’s improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive.

We have an impressive portfolio of involvement in major infrastructure projects, including delivery of projects through various consenting regimes including Development Consent Orders. We are currently leading on consenting applications for renewables and wider energy/electricity related infrastructure, transport, defence, water and much more.

You will be able to work on a range of prestigious infrastructure projects for our clients in the energy transition, rail and water development sectors, as well as regional and local developments. AECOM is a market leader in UK infrastructure development, with experience of over 80 Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects. Join us now and you could be working on:

numerous solar DCOs with a pipeline of future work;
carbon capture and energy storage projects;
energy transmission schemes including for National Grid’s Great Grid Upgrade;
large aviation and rail projects; and
housing and mixed-use development consenting.

PLANNING AT AECOM
- AECOM is a top ten UK Planning consultancy by size, employing around 70 Chartered or Licentiate Planners, practicing in all areas of the discipline. AECOM is also a worldwide leader in environmental and engineering consultancy and working as a planning consultant within AECOM means access to some of the highest profile and prestigious development projects in the UK, working with colleagues operating at the cutting edge of their disciplines as part of the largest UK environmental consultancy.

You will be joining a great team; you will have an interesting and diverse workload and you will be given the opportunity to make the most of your abilities.

What's not to like? Come and join us and we'll grow together.

Qualifications

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Professional Qualifications

Licentiate Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) or an equivalent professional town planning organisation and working towards full accreditation.

Planning & Technical Expertise

Demonstrable experience of working on major planning applications.
Sound knowledge of UK planning policy and legislation.
Experience of working on Development Consent Order (DCO) and/or Transport and Works Act Order (TWAO) applications.
Understanding of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) legislation.
Experience identifying, evaluating, and managing planning risk.

Commercial & Consultancy Skills

Commercial awareness and the ability to write clearly and concisely.
Consultancy experience, including monitoring and managing project budgets and programmes.

Stakeholder & Team Collaboration

Client-focused with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative working approach, demonstrating a high level of commitment to quality.
Experience working in collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams.

Project Delivery & Technical Competencies

Ability to work effectively to tight deadlines.
Competent in the use of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.

Additional Information

Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

For further information about the role, reach out to the recruiter on LinkedIn Anne Marie Flynn | LinkedIn

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Urban Planner (Designer)
jobs.description:
Stantec’s Buildings team is on a mission to become the world’s leading integrated design practice. Our architects, engineers, interior designers, consultants, sustainability specialists, and technologists are passionate about the power of design. Our collaborative culture and our innovative, sustainable approach to projects help us create buildings that matter to our world.

Together, we are enhancing the quality of life globally through design.

Join us and design your place with Stantec.

Stantec’s Buildings team is on a mission to become the world’s leading integrated design practice. Our architects, engineers, interior designers, consultants, sustainability specialists, and technologists are passionate about the power of design. Our collaborative culture and our innovative, sustainable approach to projects help us create buildings that matter to our world. Together, we are enhancing the quality of life globally through design. Join us and design your place with Stantec.

Your Opportunity

Stantec’s San Francisco office is seeking a motivated Campus / Urban Planner to join our Planning team. This role will support planning efforts for college and university campuses, with opportunities to contribute to related urban and community planning projects. The ideal candidate will have an educational background in both planning and design (architecture, landscape architecture, or urban design). Data analytics experience is preferred but not required.

Stantec’s Campus Planning practice is a national leader in higher education planning, delivering projects across a wide range of types and scales, including campus master plans; research, innovation, and medical district plans; and housing and student life studies. The firm also maintains a nationally recognized space analytics practice, providing space utilization and programming studies at the campus and building scales.

Key Responsibilities

Support and manage planning projects for colleges and universities, including campus master plans, district plans and site studies, as well as specialized planning studies.
Conduct research related to campus and urban planning topics.
Provide technical support to planning projects, including GIS mapping, data collection and analysis, report writing, and preparation of planning deliverables such as plans, maps, diagrams, and graphics.
Prepare graphic and written materials, including presentations, reports, and visual communication.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including planners, architects, landscape architects, urban designers, engineers, and other planning and design professionals.
Coordinate with campus clients, public agencies, consultants, and other project stakeholders.
Facilitate campus and community engagement activities, such as workshops, charrettes, and stakeholder meetings.
Support proposal development and other business development efforts.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

Professional planning experience ideally in a higher education or institutional context.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in collaborative, multidisciplinary teams on planning or design projects.
Strong work ethic with a high level of organization and attention to detail.
Proficiency in standard planning and design software tools, including Microsoft Office, InDesign, Adobe Acrobat, Bluebeam, SketchUp, Rhino, Photoshop, Illustrator, and AutoCAD (working ability with AI tools is preferred).
Working knowledge of industry-standard GIS software, such as Esri’s ArcGIS.
Strong written and verbal communications skills, including ability to prepare clear, concise planning reports and presentations to campus and public audiences.
Strong graphic skills and ability to assist and lead in the preparation of plan diagrams and graphics, including two- and three-dimensional representations at the campus, district and building scales.
Quantitative and data-analytic skills are preferred.

Education and Experience

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Urban Planning, Urban Design, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, or a related field, and a Master’s degree in a related discipline.

Professional certification / licensure or ability to obtain with one or more of the following: AICP, NOMA, AIA, LEED, LEED-ND, Sites AP, or other pertinent credentials.

Minimum of 5 years of experience in campus planning, urban planning, or related work with a private consulting firms or higher education institution is preferred.

Typical office environment working with computers and remaining sedentary for long periods of time. Field work may include exposure to the elements including inclement weather.

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee and other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.

About Stantec

Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible.

Please note, the final agreed upon compensation is based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. At Stantec certain roles are bonus eligible. Benefits Summary:
Regular full-time and part-time employees (working at least 20 hours per week) have access to medical, dental, and vision plans, a wellness program, health saving accounts, flexible spending accounts, 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase program, life and accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, short-term/long-term disability plans, emergency travel benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional membership fee coverage and paid family leave. Regular full-time and part-time employees will receive ten paid holidays in each calendar year. In addition, employees will be eligible to accrue vacation between 10 and 20 days per year and eligible for paid sick leave (and if more generous, in accordance with state and local law).

Temporary/casual employees have access to 401(k) plans, employee stock purchase program, and paid leave, in accordance with state and local law.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

AECOM’s Urbanism + Planning practice is a continuum of design vision and strategic advisory that transforms communities. We lead through integration, shaping the social infrastructure that connects us all. U+P’s primary focus includes urban planning, urban design, landscape architecture, workplace strategy, business transformation, asset advisory, economics, and environmental planning.

With a range of expertise from strategy and design through project realization, we create better outcomes to grow economies, protect natural systems, conserve natural resources, make societies more equitable, and connect and engage people through innovative, sustainable design solutions.

Job Description

AECOM
is seeking a Senior Urban Planning Project Managerto support our growing Buildings & Places Business Line. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. AECOM’s Urbanism + Planning team is seeking a creative and experienced urban planner or urban designer to join its practice to manage and contribute to complex projects.

The role will lead transformative, large-scale urban design and master planning projects across the East Coast, with a focus on TOD, mixed-use development, placemaking, downtown revitalization, and public realm design in the Washington, DC region. Working collaboratively with urban designers, planners, landscape architects, engineers, and economists, the urban planner or urban designer will provide planning and urban design leadership, project management, client engagement, and business development for municipal, state, and private-sector clients.

Our teams have worked on transformative planning and urban design projects for high profile clients through the United States, including for major transit, transportation, economic development, and planning agencies.

The job responsibilities for the position will include but are not limited to:

Project Management & Leadership:
In partnership with various Urbanism + Planning studios, lead complex, multidisciplinary projects from concept through implementation, including master plans, economic development strategies, land use and built form studies, public realm strategies, placemaking initiatives, and urban design guidelines.
Manage project scope, schedule, budget, work plans, and deliverables across multiple concurrent projects, project phases, and multidisciplinary teams.
Establish and maintain planning and urban design direction, quality, and consistency throughout project delivery while balancing innovation, feasibility, budget, and schedule.

Technical Support & Plan Production:
Prepare conditions assessments, land use and real estate analysis, diagrams and renderings, and high-quality presentations and reports that effectively communicate planning concepts, economic development considerations, and urban design vision for complex projects.
Lead and coordinate interdisciplinary teams, integrating civil, structural, transportation, environmental, landscape, and other technical disciplines into cohesive and viable planning and urban design solutions.
Translate complex planning and urban design concepts into clear, compelling diagrams, visualizations, reports, and presentations for a range of audiences.
Lead stakeholder engagement strategies and creative outreach efforts, including brand development, professional templates and style guides, event planning, meeting facilitation, online forums, and digital tools.

Client Relationships & Business Development:
Lead and support client presentations, workshops, stakeholder meetings, and public engagement sessions with confidence, enthusiasm, and clarity.
Lead and support proposal development, scopes of work, fee and budget development, work plans, and project interviews.
Support client relationship-building efforts, identifying opportunities to expand existing relationships and develop new business.
Represent AECOM by presenting at industry conferences and through participation in organizations.

Qualifications

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
BA/BS in Planning, Urban Design, Landscape Architecture or related field + 8 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
Demonstrated project management experience on complex, multidisciplinary, large-scale planning, urban design, and economic development projects, especially in urban and mixed-use contexts

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Masters Degree in Planning, Urban Design, Landscape Architecture or related field
Business development experience, including supporting and leading urban design and planning proposals for public sector and private sector clients
Significant experience producing high-quality written narrative and graphics for reports and presentations, with the ability to present ideas effectively to internal and external audiences
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign).
Advanced proficiency directing and reviewing urban design production, including 2D and 3D site plans, building massing studies, diagrams, and renderings
Proficiency in GIS and map-based data analytics
Positive, proactive approach to teamwork and problem-solving
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
Excellent time management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
AICP certification or active pursuit of certification preferred

Additional Information

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
Relocation is not available for this position.

To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

With Every Community, Stantec Redefines What’s Possible.

Application Deadline:
Recruitment is ongoing. Please apply as soon as possible as the advert may close once we have sufficient applicants.

The Opportunity

Join our 2027 Graduate Programme as a Graduate Planner (Major Projects) in our Glasgow office, where you will support major water sector programmes and nationally significant infrastructure projects across the UK.

You will join our national project planning team, which includes 15 colleagues across nine offices, with Glasgow and Reading acting as key planning hubs. The role sits within the Water sector and will support projects nationwide across the wide range of long-term frameworks we hold with water companies.

You will support Strategic Resource Options, which are major projects due to their scale, project cost and nationally significant status. Working under the guidance of a senior planner, you will contribute to Stantec’s design delivery across stages ranging from concept design through to construction phase support.

Take a look at our Water business line here: Water (stantec.com), and review the career journey of some of our early careers professionals here: Career Stories | Stantec.

About The Role

As part of our Major Projects planning team, you will support programme planning, reporting and governance activities that help major water sector projects progress effectively. Your core responsibilities include:

Creating NEC3/4 CL31 and CL32 Primavera P6 programmes.
Updating P6 programmes with monthly progress information.
Producing reports, data analysis and governance materials.
Contributing programme information during client updates.
Supporting collaboration workshops with project design teams and discipline leads.
Supporting compliance with NEC conditions of contract in the production of tender and contractual programme documentation.

We are committed to supporting employees in achieving relevant professional qualifications and accreditation. This role will support professional development through the APM pathway, alongside in-house training and shadowing in Primavera P6, NEC training, QSRA training, Power BI training and wider project planning team learning opportunities.

Your Impact

This role will help deliver better outcomes for communities and the environment by supporting the planning and delivery of nationally significant water sector projects. Your work will contribute to effective programme management, governance and collaboration across major projects that support long-term water resilience and infrastructure delivery.

About You

At Stantec, we value your potential over past experience. Along with your Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Chemical or Mechanical Engineering and a keen interest in the water industry, we’d love to receive your application if you are:-

An adapter: you’re able to remain calm in new and changing situations, comfortably switching between a variety of dynamic and exciting tasks.
A Perseverer: you stay composed in the face of setbacks, approaching challenges with confidence and determination.
A Collaborator: you work effectively with lots of different people, considering other’s perspectives to shape better outcomes.
A Problem-Solver: you love to give your thoughts based on what you see, being unafraid to challenge conventional thinking.

Please note, we ask our graduates to come into the office 4 days per week, to ensure that colleagues are able to provide the appropriate level of support.

Applicants must have an unconditional right to live and work in the UK for an indefinite period without limitation.

What We Can Offer You

A competitive salary
Private medical insurance
A range of benefits, including holiday buy and sell, group income protection and life assurance
Permanent employment contract to demonstrate our commitment to your long-term career at Stantec
Professional progression plan, supporting you to become chartered with ICE.
A supportive and collaborative team environment and Early Careers peer group and wider ERG network (see more on our ERGs here: Stantec Employee Resource Groups )

Please take a look at our Graduate FAQs (
Graduate Application FAQs
) if you have any questions. We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Town Planner
jobs.description:
TOWN OF STONINGTON

POSITION VACANCY

TOWN PLANNER

Salary Range -
$84,470.08 to $115,431.22 (commensurate with experience)

Full-time, Exempt, Union position, 35 hrs/week w/benefits*

Working under the supervision of the Director of Land Use & Development, the Town Planner is responsible for planning, organizing, directing and participating in the performance of the activities of the Land Use and Development Department. Provides technical support to the town’s several Land Use Regulatory Agencies, the Board of Selectmen, and Land Use Boards and Commissions. Provides information and technical assistance to the general public, property owners, contractors, and developers, and their representatives. Reviews and makes recommendations on land development proposals including commercial/office, tourist/recreational, industrial and residential. May make site inspections for proposed subdivisions and developments. Coordinates reviews with other departments. Confers and consults with other town officials, attorneys, builders, and the general public regarding proposals. Works to resolve conflicts among parties consistent with Town Planning goals. The position requires the use of independent judgment, initiative, and supervisory skills.

The education, experience and training required would generally be acquired with a Bachelor’s Degree in Urban, Regional or Community Planning or a related field with concentrated course work in Land Use Planning and three (3) years professional experience in Land Use Planning or Natural Resource Management preferred. Master’s Degree in City, Urban and Regional Planning may be substituted for two (2) years of professional experience; or any equivalent combination of education, training and experience that demonstrates the ability to successfully perform the essential duties of the position may be considered. Certification by the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) is desirable. Motor Vehicle Operator’s License, required.

The Town of Stonington conducts a criminal background and drug test as part of the hiring process. Please visit www.stonington-ct.gov to review the complete job description and how to apply.

Receipt of all materials must be received no later than 3:30 pm on Monday, October 26, 2026.

This position is benefits eligible and includes medical, dental & vision, employer HSA contribution, 401(a) and optional 457(b) retirement plans, generous accrued leave time (vacation, sick, personal), 13 paid holidays, employer sponsored life insurance including AD&D, and employee assistance program. The inclusion of this information is in accordance with Connecticut Public Act No. 26-12. Benefits are subject to the terms of the Union Collective Bargaining Agreement.

to serve as the analytical engine behind how Procore’s Customer Success organization measures and improves performance. As a Senior CS Analyst on our Customer Journey and Outcomes (CJ&O)

and can be based remotely within the US.

Build Operating Reporting Stacks: Own the executive dashboards, scorecards, and reporting infrastructure feeding CCO weekly cadences, QBRs, and new customer health frameworks.
Support Account Prioritization Systems: Deliver reporting layers covering segment trends, reason codes, usage fidelity, and lookback accuracy to flag classification performance.
Define and Evaluate Health Flags: Partner with Product and CS leaders to spec logic, validate signals, and measure the real-world efficacy of risk and expansion alerts in production.
QA Data Products: Validate outputs, establish requirements, and document limitations across core scoring tools, churn/expansion models, and predictive models.
Drive Segment and Portfolio Reviews: Build analytical infrastructure to surface cohort trends, rate-of-change metrics, and book anomalies for leadership decision-making.
Power Product Intelligence Loops: Maintain underlying data models connecting customer value achievement directly to incoming product feedback requests.
Manage End-to-End Data Operations: Query and clean multi-source data across Snowflake, Salesforce, and Gong while partnering with Data Ops to resolve core data quality issues.

What You Bring

3+ years of experience in SaaS CS analytics, revenue analytics, or business intelligence, including strong foundational knowledge of post-sales metrics like GRR, NRR, churn, expansion, and health scores.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business, Statistics, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
Advanced SQL Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to write, debug, and optimize complex queries independently across messy, unrefined datasets.
Hands-on BI & Reporting Expertise: Proven track record building executive-ready dashboards in Tableau, Coefficient, or similar enterprise reporting environments.
Data QA & Modeling Exposure: Experience evaluating, validating, and documenting predictive models or scoring outputs within an operational business context.
Modern Tech Stack Familiarity: Working knowledge of cloud data environments like Snowflake or Databricks.
Investigation & Communication Skills: Proven ability to investigate data anomalies independently, synthesize complex metrics into actionable insights, and navigate evolving frameworks with structured execution.
AI Workflow Integration: Ability to leverage modern AI tools for data exploration, rapid synthesis, and process automation.

Strong-Fit Background Might Include

Prior experience within Procore systems or post-sales GTM operations.
Experience in post-sales revenue operations within enterprise SaaS or B2B platforms.
Background partnering directly with GTM operations and data engineering teams to ship GTM reporting models.

Start here. Grown Here.

AECOM’s Planning and Stakeholder Engagement business is recruiting Consultant Planners to help deliver our existing portfolio of projects and a pipeline of projects, across a range of sectors, principally delivering large scale infrastructure.

carbon capture and energy storage projects;
energy transmission schemes including for National Grid’s Great Grid Upgrade;
large aviation and rail projects; and
housing and mixed-use development consenting.

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Licentiate Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) or an equivalent professional town planning organisation and working towards full accreditation.

Sound knowledge of UK planning policy and legislation.

Client-focused with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative working approach, demonstrating a high level of commitment to quality.
Experience working in collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams.

Competent in the use of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Project.

Smith is the leading independent electronic components distributor in the world. Since our founding in 1984, Smith’s Intelligent Distribution model and commitment to quality has allowed us to deliver comprehensive solutions to electronic component supply chains. We work across a variety of industries including automotive, supercomputing, gaming, medical devices, oil and gas, and more. Additionally, we provide tailored supply chain solutions such as counterfeit testing, vendor inventory management, and sustainable hardware disposition. We're excited to meet you and share what we love about Smith!

Job Purpose

To support Operations and Legal teams by ensuring Smith’s compliance with regional and global trade compliance regulations.

Essential Job Duties

Understand regional and global rules and regulatory requirements and advise management/adapt processes where required
Ensure Smith’s adherence to regulatory requirements relating to activities such as import/export controls, etc.
Provide general trade compliance guidance and support to Smith’s internal stakeholders
Assist in execution of internal and external audits relating to trade compliance and implementation of corrective actions
Work with Export Licensing and Quality Control teams to research and maintain customs related master data (e.g., part type classification information)
Work with third party service providers (e.g., freight forwarders) to ensure proper execution of and documentation for international shipments
Investigate and report unusual business activity that may result in a violation and/or inquiry to senior management

Experience

Job Qualifications

3+ years of trade compliance experience preferred
3+ years of experience with HTS database management preferred
Prior experience working in the semiconductor/electronics distribution industry a plus
Proficient oral and written communication skills in English are required
Must be detail oriented and organized
Self-motivated and able to work with minimum supervision

Education

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (i.e., logistics or supply chain) or equivalent job experience preferred

Certifications

ECTI certification preferred

Software Requirements

Working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite
Experience with DNB, Alliance or other trade compliance tools

Additional Skills

Capable of interpreting regulations and translating them into business practices
Strong analytical, problem solving, negotiation, organizational and teaching skills
Ability to drive compliance behaviors in good balance with business objectives

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.

new_jobs.title: Town Planner
new_jobs.description:
TOWN OF STONINGTON

POSITION VACANCY

TOWN PLANNER

Salary Range -
$84,470.08 to $115,431.22 (commensurate with experience)

Full-time, Exempt, Union position, 35 hrs/week w/benefits*

Working under the supervision of the Director of Land Use & Development, the Town Planner is responsible for planning, organizing, directing and participating in the performance of the activities of the Land Use and Development Department. Provides technical support to the town’s several Land Use Regulatory Agencies, the Board of Selectmen, and Land Use Boards and Commissions. Provides information and technical assistance to the general public, property owners, contractors, and developers, and their representatives. Reviews and makes recommendations on land development proposals including commercial/office, tourist/recreational, industrial and residential. May make site inspections for proposed subdivisions and developments. Coordinates reviews with other departments. Confers and consults with other town officials, attorneys, builders, and the general public regarding proposals. Works to resolve conflicts among parties consistent with Town Planning goals. The position requires the use of independent judgment, initiative, and supervisory skills.

The education, experience and training required would generally be acquired with a Bachelor’s Degree in Urban, Regional or Community Planning or a related field with concentrated course work in Land Use Planning and three (3) years professional experience in Land Use Planning or Natural Resource Management preferred. Master’s Degree in City, Urban and Regional Planning may be substituted for two (2) years of professional experience; or any equivalent combination of education, training and experience that demonstrates the ability to successfully perform the essential duties of the position may be considered. Certification by the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) is desirable. Motor Vehicle Operator’s License, required.

The Town of Stonington conducts a criminal background and drug test as part of the hiring process. Please visit www.stonington-ct.gov to review the complete job description and how to apply.

Receipt of all materials must be received no later than 3:30 pm on Monday, October 26, 2026.

This position is benefits eligible and includes medical, dental & vision, employer HSA contribution, 401(a) and optional 457(b) retirement plans, generous accrued leave time (vacation, sick, personal), 13 paid holidays, employer sponsored life insurance including AD&D, and employee assistance program. The inclusion of this information is in accordance with Connecticut Public Act No. 26-12. Benefits are subject to the terms of the Union Collective Bargaining Agreement.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Outcomes Senior Analyst (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
Procore Technologies is the leading technology platform for every stage of construction. We empower construction teams to drive efficiency and mitigate risk through actionable AI & data-driven insights. For over 20 years, we’ve been transforming the industry with purpose-built solutions for construction professionals, and we’re looking for talented people to help us build together.

We are looking for a Senior CS Outcomes Analyst
to serve as the analytical engine behind how Procore’s Customer Success organization measures and improves performance. As a Senior CS Analyst on our Customer Journey and Outcomes (CJ&O)
team, you’ll work closely with Customer Success leadership, Product, and Data Engineering to build reliable reporting, scale health frameworks, and transform complex post-sales data into clear operating decisions. Your strengths in advanced SQL, SaaS post-sales metrics, and data product QA will drive your success as we shift toward outcomes-based customer accountability.

You will report to the Director of Customer Journey and Outcomes
and can be based remotely within the US.

What You’ll Do

Build Operating Reporting Stacks: Own the executive dashboards, scorecards, and reporting infrastructure feeding CCO weekly cadences, QBRs, and new customer health frameworks.
Support Account Prioritization Systems: Deliver reporting layers covering segment trends, reason codes, usage fidelity, and lookback accuracy to flag classification performance.
Define and Evaluate Health Flags: Partner with Product and CS leaders to spec logic, validate signals, and measure the real-world efficacy of risk and expansion alerts in production.
QA Data Products: Validate outputs, establish requirements, and document limitations across core scoring tools, churn/expansion models, and predictive models.
Drive Segment and Portfolio Reviews: Build analytical infrastructure to surface cohort trends, rate-of-change metrics, and book anomalies for leadership decision-making.
Power Product Intelligence Loops: Maintain underlying data models connecting customer value achievement directly to incoming product feedback requests.
Manage End-to-End Data Operations: Query and clean multi-source data across Snowflake, Salesforce, and Gong while partnering with Data Ops to resolve core data quality issues.

What You Bring

3+ years of experience in SaaS CS analytics, revenue analytics, or business intelligence, including strong foundational knowledge of post-sales metrics like GRR, NRR, churn, expansion, and health scores.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business, Statistics, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
Advanced SQL Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to write, debug, and optimize complex queries independently across messy, unrefined datasets.
Hands-on BI & Reporting Expertise: Proven track record building executive-ready dashboards in Tableau, Coefficient, or similar enterprise reporting environments.
Data QA & Modeling Exposure: Experience evaluating, validating, and documenting predictive models or scoring outputs within an operational business context.
Modern Tech Stack Familiarity: Working knowledge of cloud data environments like Snowflake or Databricks.
Investigation & Communication Skills: Proven ability to investigate data anomalies independently, synthesize complex metrics into actionable insights, and navigate evolving frameworks with structured execution.
AI Workflow Integration: Ability to leverage modern AI tools for data exploration, rapid synthesis, and process automation.

Strong-Fit Background Might Include

Prior experience within Procore systems or post-sales GTM operations.
Experience in post-sales revenue operations within enterprise SaaS or B2B platforms.
Background partnering directly with GTM operations and data engineering teams to ship GTM reporting models.

Additional Information

Base Pay Range:

129,600.00 - 178,200.00 USD Annual

This role may also be eligible for Equity Compensation and/or Bonus Incentive Compensation. Procore is committed to offering competitive, fair, and commensurate compensation. Actual compensation will be based on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, education or training, and location.

For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:

Procore will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the requirements of applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

A criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: 1. appropriately managing, accessing, and handling confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information, as well as accessing Procore's information technology systems and platforms; 2. interacting with and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external customers, stakeholders, and/or colleagues; and 3. exercising sound judgment.
